description: This file defines the class AssumeRoleCredentialProvider, which provides AWS credentials by assuming a role using AWS STS. It includes methods for constructing the provider with required parameters and asynchronously obtaining credentials.

classes.name: AssumeRoleCredentialProvider
classes.description: Credential provider that assumes an AWS IAM role using STS and fetches temporary credentials asynchronously.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with AWS STS client and assume role parameters. Throws exception if required config options are missing.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Loads credentials by calling assumeRoleAsync on the STS client and processes the result to produce credentials or throw an exception on failure.
